followups.problem: The Hive's own 'Command Center' tab is still href '/command-center' with no location.search. Its Classic tab (line 674) already keeps the query. This was there before the delta; delta 2 did not touch it.
followups.exploit_or_failure: Clicking the Hive's 'Command Center' tab (aria-current, so a reload of the same view) on a token-only session lands on a tokenless URL, and the watch server answers 403.
followups.fix: Use `tabHive.href = `/command-center${win.location?.search || ''}`` to match the Classic tab and the Cockpit fix.

followups.problem: The Hive's Cockpit tab href is '/command-center/project/<id>' with no query. A plain click is caught by the JS handler (line 1120), but ctrl/meta/shift/middle-click is let through on purpose and follows the raw href. This was there before the delta.
followups.exploit_or_failure: Opening the Cockpit in a new tab loses the page token, and the server answers 403.
followups.fix: Append win.location?.search to the Cockpit href too. Add an assertion for it next to the Cockpit tab test.

followups.problem: assertCockpitViewTabsPreservePageToken uses a fixed fake search '?t=abc' and only compares strings. It never sends the rendered href to the running server. Its mock querySelectorAll also ignores the selector, so it returns every <a> under any .tabs node.
followups.exploit_or_failure: If the server's token parameter name or format changed, this test would still pass, but the rendered link would 403.
followups.fix: Pass `?${on.pageQuery()}` as the fake location.search. Then request tabs[1].href and tabs[0].href against on.port and assert status 200 (and BOARD_MARK for Classic). Also give the Cockpit-tabs check its own test() so a failure there is reported separately.

followups.problem: No test covers the no-window/no-defaultView path in the new tab code. The existing mount tests pass no window and have no document.defaultView, so they do run it, but nothing asserts the hrefs there.
followups.exploit_or_failure: A later change that throws or prints 'undefined' into the href when location is missing (SSR/tests) would not be caught by an explicit assertion.
followups.fix: In one of the existing no-window tests, assert that the Cockpit tabs are '/command-center' and '/classic' when there is no location.

summary: Token blocker CLOSED. cc-cockpit-mount.js:214 reads `win.location?.search || doc.defaultView?.location?.search || ''` and appends it to both the Command Center and Classic tab hrefs. The Command Center tab keeps aria-current='page'. The search value comes from same-origin location and sits after a fixed path, so it cannot inject a scheme. The new routes-flag test renders the real Cockpit with location.search '?t=abc' and asserts '/command-center?t=abc' (with aria-current) and '/classic?t=abc'. The old tokenless '/classic' form would fail that strict equality. The test replaces a source-regex check that also matched the tokenless form, so it is stronger, not weaker. No new blocker: (1) Without a window or defaultView (SSR and the existing cc-cockpit-mount tests, which pass neither), win falls back to globalThis, both optional chains give undefined, search becomes '', and the hrefs keep their old values. The tabs are built before the try-wrapped paint(), so a partial DOM cannot drop them. (2) cc-hive-mount.js is not in the delta, so Hive tab behavior is unchanged. (3) No money or login change: the money assertions (assertSnapshotNoMoney on both APIs) and all 403-without-token and 200-with-token checks are still in place. (4) No test was removed or loosened beyond swapping the regex for the rendered assertion. Follow-ups: the Hive's own Command Center and Cockpit tab links still drop the token (both pre-existing), and the new test could send the rendered href to the live server. Limits: this review is static. I did not run the tests because shell access was not allowed, and I read only the six listed context files.
